units.name: Institute of Design, Robotics and Manufacturing
units.school: School of Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering and Physical Sciences
units.evidence: Actual school research inventory and institute overview establish institute identity and parent. Manufacturing modeling/simulation remit explicitly covers smart production planning and efficient resource-management algorithms, beyond physical fabrication/control alone.

decisions.reason: Descriptive research/recruiting topic is not a named academic unit; verified current operations department and center retained separately.

limitations: Older Centre for Operations and Supply Chain Research page remains accessible, but current department directory links TOSCA instead. Retain the current linked center without asserting an unverified exact rename date. Imported disaster-response wording is a project/recruiting topic, not an established department name.

New institute qualifies for stated production-planning/resource-management research scope. Generic materials, robotics and physical manufacturing are not all relabelled Industrial Engineering; no separate IE department asserted.
